description: Today Defk.Build calls System.cmd($CC or cc) and a missing compiler surfaces as a bare :enoent. Raise a kernel compile error in the agreed format (see defk-vku) that names $CC, says a C toolchain is needed at build time, and gives the per-OS install hint (macOS: xcode-select --install; Debian/Ubuntu: build-essential; Alpine: build-base). Also honour ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR (elixir_make convention) before falling back to the running ERTS's include dir, so cross-builds can point at the target's headers. Decided in defk-dtw.11. Done when: a test with CC pointing at a nonexistent binary asserts the message, and ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR overrides the include path.
title: Actionable error when no C compiler is found
